displayAddress: Stafford Yard, Stafford Street, Bedminster, Bristol, Bristol City
description:
This is the final 1 bedroom unit available for move in!

Furniture is not included in the listed rate.

Welcome to Stafford Yard, a stunning new residential development in the heart of Bedminster, Bristol. This collection of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, including stylish duplexes, has been designed for modern urban living. Thoughtfully planned open layouts, sleek kitchens, and high-end finishes create the perfect living environment. 

At Stafford Yard, residents can enjoy an exceptional range of on-site amenities. Stay active in the state-of-the-art gym, host gatherings in the chef's kitchen, or unwind in the resident lounge and games lounge. Need to focus? Our co-working spaces and bookable meeting rooms provide the perfect setup for remote work and collaboration. The courtyard offers beautifully landscaped outdoor space for relaxation.

Located in one of Bristol's most exciting regeneration areas, Stafford Yard is just a short walk from Bedminster station, providing excellent transport links to London and beyond. Enjoy easy access to Cabot Circus shopping, Harbourside dining, and Bristol's famous street art scene. With nearby parks, cultural attractions, and lively cafés, this is city living at its finest. 

Professionally managed by CompassRock, with on-site concierge services and 24/7 maintenance support, we ensure a seamless and stress-free renting experience. Whether you are looking for a stylish studio or a spacious duplex, Stafford Yard is designed to meet the needs of modern renters. 

Book your viewing today and discover contemporary living in the heart of vibrant city! 

Utilities are not included in monthly rent. 

The Fine Print: 
1. Images are reflective of the SHOW APARTMENT, so styles and layouts may vary. We have a range of apartment layouts and sizes available, please get in touch to arrange a viewing.
2. Broadband - £40 monthly charge apply- 1GB upload and download speed. 
3. Parking - Standard space £150pcm, premium space £200pcm, subject to license agreement.
4. Furniture is not included in listed rent price.
5. Utilities- Are the responsibility of the resident and are not included in the rent. 
6. Concessions/Special Offers - applied to selected apartments only- terms and conditions apply.
